name: Remote Forbidden-Minor Single-Clause Pivot Tower
definition: For the rooted pair $B_j,K_j$, take a fresh-coordinate copy $T$ of $B_0$, form $B_j\vee T$ and $K_j\vee T$ at zero, and in each add the same square tip across one common root direction of the first block and one root direction of $T$. Denote the completed families by $X_j,Y_j$.
parameters: For $j\ge0$, both families have $(581\cdot3^j+575)/2$ concepts, dimension $24+2j$, and VC dimension $3+j$.
properties: Both are two-connected and ample; $X_j$ is pc-minimal outside dismantlable ampleness, while $Y_j$ is dismantlable ample. Every proper pc-minor of either peels. Their shadows coincide, exactly one four-support clause changes to its antipodal sign, and their marked-zero neighborhoods agree through radius $j+4$ with first difference at radius $j+5$.
